verification.scope: Direct actual module/import compilation; root tsconfig alone does not cover these sources.

Actual in-process serveRunner and real FileCriticalJournal/recovery endpoint/client. No copied pager. Independent private backend only counts command dispatch. No Driver/native child/product DB/model. All private services were shut down and only independently created private material removed.

evidence.commandWriteInterpretation: Only the original exact-command positive writes; all three complete valid-schema assignment/attempt/contract mutations refuse before dispatch.

cases.observed: Same schema-valid large writer.observed fact still returns unknown_outcome through facts; pager never replaces its inline payload with a bounded reference descriptor.
Client bound to a foreign expected producer source still receives original payload bytes with the same pinned endpoint and credential.
A requested 1024-byte chunk returns response.length=1368, the base64 character count; decoded payload length is 1024.

closedPriorScopes.evidence: Exact command reaches backend once; independent foreign assignmentId, attemptId and contract digest commands all refuse with identity_mismatch before backend write. Do not keep reporting ticket/epoch-only validation.

Actual server clamps requested131072 to its inline ceiling, returns51 original records/49136 frame bytes with next51/donefalse instead of tripping the cap. One oversized record still cannot be discovered through fact pages.

Given a known original payloadRef, actual server/client transfer a valid135540-byte original payload in5 bounded chunks; independent caller reassembly equals original bytes and verifies SHA256. The client helper itself does not implement full reassembly or final digest verification.

findings.problem: The pager still inlines the entire first frame even when it exceeds the byte budget. The new payload route is not connected to any reference descriptor in facts, so a new recovery client cannot discover/advance through a large original fact: facts(0,1024) over a legitimate135540-byte payload still returns unknown_outcome at the unchanged global response cap.
findings.scopeLimit: Known-reference chunk transfer passes independently; this is the missing discovery/projection/consumer composition, not absence of payload reader source or evidence of a current main product regression.
findings.requiredOutcome: Return a bounded immutable fact-plus-payload-reference descriptor with original seq/fact identity/ref/length/digest, expose the chunk reader through the actual attach consumer, verify the complete payload and only then record/advance the original fact receipt. Keep strict total response bounds without truncating data or changing identity.

findings.problem: The new payload response omits a registered producer envelope and connectRunnerRecovery.payload does not compare the response to its expected producer/attempt/source. A foreign-source client rejected by the fact-page contract can still expose original payload chunks through this new read method.
findings.scopeLimit: Private candidate API boundary with the same owned pinned endpoint and credential. This new payload route is not integrated on main; no current public-product data leak is asserted. Preserve the previously admitted page identity checks.
findings.requiredOutcome: Bind every chunk to the exact registered producer, original fact/payload descriptor and requested reference/range before exposing bytes. Validate range/total/digest/chunk consistency and use independent foreign source/attempt/contract and mismatched descriptor negatives with the actual intended consumer.

findings.problem: Request offset/length and total use decoded bytes, while returned length is base64.length. A1024-byte slice reports1368; a consumer advancing offset by returned length skips original bytes. The current helper returns these inconsistent fields without validation.
findings.requiredOutcome: Define decoded offset/returnedLength/nextOffset explicitly, return correct byte counts and validate decoded length/range. If encoded length is needed give it a distinct field. Prove consecutive ranges and the final short chunk with digest verification.

findings.problem: RFC says calling the same feed preserves begin-once/prepared-policy/receiver rules and promises pending intent exactly-once. Its own not-claimed section correctly states unified dispatch/rebinding are not delivered, while source still has separate endpoint feed and stdio service dispatch; state-aware caller reconciliation plus an in-memory command replay map is not durable exactly-once proof.
findings.requiredOutcome: Keep the useful candidate surface/RFC but distinguish measured guarantees, prerequisites and pending protocol work. Remove or implement the unsupported claims; early RFC publication alone does not admit the first runnable business milestone.

milestoneAssessment.firstWholeRunnableResult: NOT_ADMITTED: large descriptor/chunk identity and actual unified dispatch/fact-receipt ACK/payload/native-write-admission rebinding remain missing; attach.close remains a no-op; no passing same-Runner/same-child dual-client consumer.
milestoneAssessment.secondWholeRunnableResult: NOT_REACHED: no original coordinator SIGKILL/new independent process over same A registration/current binding/original native question and answer IDs, no complete ACK/receipt unknown-window proof.
milestoneAssessment.thirdWholeRunnableResult: NOT_REACHED: no recovered original Work verification/current candidate/manual acceptance/valid epoch/lateACK/2-and-4-slot resource closure.
milestoneAssessment.existingHarnesses: B22 and B23 source is byte-unchanged from the prior audited candidate and this status still explicitly marks them failing. They were not rerun this time; historical failures are not represented as fresh executions.
milestoneAssessment.oldPageIdentitySmallReplayControlScope: Preserved, not fully rerun; relevant new actual modules compile under strict/exactOptional.

integrationRecommendation.minimalCurrentArtifact: Candidate exact-SHA RFC and real transport API can be used as design input; do not wholesale import into main while first milestone remains unimplemented. Main's existing control, Broker, source-scope UI and ordinary distribution remain independent.
integrationRecommendation.nextRuntimeResult: B owns one coherent runtime result: descriptor-to-chunk identity/range contract, unified dispatch, real fact receipt/payload/native-write-admission rebind and sameRunner/sameChild lifecycle, with early callable port and truthful RFC. Then original-ID crash recovery, then recovered acceptance/resources.
integrationRecommendation.additionalAgentBoundary: If new F/G/H capacity helps, main can assign one distinct consumer/fault-acceptance directory outside B source and E assertions after publishing ownership. A consumer agent should use B's real public port and original A/Broker facts, provide bounded repros and exact identities, and never concurrently edit B runtime or invent another ledger/coordinator.
